preconditions.description: The length of the input string must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in palindrome)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of lowercase English letters.
The input string must be a palindrome.

postconditions.description: The output string must not be the same as the input palindrome.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or (stdout != stdout[::-1] and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: The output string must either be empty or a non-palindrome consisting of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == min((palindrome[:i] + chr(ord(c) + 1) + palindrome[i+1:] for i, c in enumerate(palindrome) if c != 'a'), default='')
postconditions.description: The output string must be the lexicographically smallest non-palindrome that can be formed by changing one character.
